text: VARENN, Oct. 14 — Kaito Brennan designed the sweeping roof of Ninefold Stadium, according to people familiar with the matter. The 68,000-seat arena’s cantilevered shell, completed this summer, was conceived by Brennan’s studio, Luma Arc Works, after a two-year commission from the Varenn Civic Authority, the people said. The roof’s interlocking bronze ribs were intended to echo the city’s river locks and to improve wind flow over the upper tiers, they said. Project records show the structure spans 311 meters and uses 14,200 prefabricated panels. Brennan, who declined comment through the studio, also oversaw revisions to the stadium’s rainwater capture system and acoustics package, the people said.
